name: click_element_by_text
description: Finds and clicks a target button or interactive link on the webpage matching the given text label.
codeSnippet: const targetText = (params.text || '').toLowerCase(); const element = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, input[type="submit"]')).find(el => el.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(targetText)); if (element) { element.click(); return { clicked: true, text: element.innerText }; } return { clicked: false, error: 'Element not found' };
